title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Manufacturer Mail-In Rebate Programme Table
content:
Manufacturer mail-in rebate offers apply to purchases made through Northgate Purchases & Returns only on the channels the programme lists. The table sets eligibility, the claim window counted from the fulfillment date, and how an approved rebate is paid.

| Channel | Purchases qualify for mail-in rebate offers | Claim window (calendar days after the fulfillment date) | Approved rebate paid as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | yes | 30 | Northgate Shop Card |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | yes | 30 | Northgate Shop Card |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | no | 0 | Northgate Shop Card |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | yes | 30 | Northgate Shop Card |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | yes | 30 | Northgate Shop Card |
| Northgate Special Order | no | 0 | Northgate Shop Card |

### Notes

- The two channels outside the programme, the Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order and the Northgate Special Order, carry a claim window of 0.
- The 30-day channel window runs alongside each offer's own claim deadline; the payment tender is a Northgate Shop Card on every channel.

Hypothetical reading: a printer with a rebate offer bought as a Northgate Business Delivery Order qualifies for the programme; the same printer bought as a Northgate Special Order does not.
